oa: KÙ ša qá-ta-at A-al-DÙG a-šu-mì Ki-li-ri-e ni-il5-tap-tù KÙ šu-qú-ul
english: The silver for which we had ourselves registered as guarantors of Al-ṭāb concerning the Kilirians, pay that silver.

oa: um-ma Šu-Ištar-ma a-na 6 ITU.KAM ki-ma a-wa-at a-li-a: a-lá-kam-ma a-wa-tám a-dá-na-kum
english: Šu-Ištar answered: Within 6 months, in accordance with the ruling of my city, I will come and render account to you.

oa: um-ma En-na-Sú-[in]-ma šu-ma a-na 6 ITU.KAM a-na Ta-wi-ni-a lá [ta]-lá-kam-ma a-wa-tám lá ta-dí-nam
english: Ennam-Suen said: If you do not come to Tawiniya within 6 months and do not render account to me,

oa: ba-lum di-nim ba-lúm ma-mì-tim KÙ ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu lá ta-dá-nam
english: will you then not give me the silver and its interest without resorting to legal action or oath?

oa: um-ma Šu-Ištar-ma lá-dí-na-kum
english: Šu-Ištar answered: I will give it you.

oa: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um Ta-wi-ni-a i-di-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša A-šur ṭup-pá-am a-ni-am ni-dí-in
english: For these words the Tawiniya colony made us appear in court and before Aššur's dagger we gave this tablet.

oa: IGI Ištar-ba-ni IGI Ší-ma-ta-nim IGI Zu-NI-a Ma-num-ba-lúm-A-šur DUMU Du-ni-a ra-bu-ni
english: Witnessed by Ištar-bāni, by Šimatānum, by Zulniya; Mannum-balum-Aššur, son of Dunniya, was our fourth man.

oa: a-na A-šur-UTU ù En-na-Sú-in qi-bi4-ma um-ma A-al-DÙG-ma
english: Say to Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen, thus Āl-ṭāb.

oa: a-na A-šur-UTU qi-bi4-ma mi-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma al-kam ṣí-tám ni-ša-kà-an
english: Say in particular to Aššur-šamšī: Why are you writing me as follows: Come here, we must submit the expenditures?

oa: tám-kà-ru-um i-na re-ší-a i-za-az KÙ.B. 1 ma-na a-ša-qá-al
english: The creditor keeps a check on me (because) I have to pay 1 mina of silver!

oa: ke-e lá-li-kà-am ú-lá 10 GÍN KÙ.B. i-na qá-tí-a i-ba-ší
english: How could I come while I do not even have 10 shekels of silver available?

oa: a-hu-a a-tù-nu a-dí ITU.1.KAM qá-i-a-ni
english: Please, my brothers, wait one month more for me.

oa: šu-ma e-mu-qá-tám e-pá-áš-ku-nu-ma ma a-kà-ri-im i-lá-ak-ma kà-ru-um i-da-ku-nu ù a-na-ku qá-dí-ku-nu-ma
english: If he treats you in a violent way, yea even turns to the colony and the colony makes you appear in court, then I am with you in it!

oa: a-bi4 a-ta šé-ṭù-ta-kà a-na-ku a-lá-qé a-lá-nu-kà-a
english: My dear father, could I hold you in contempt?

oa: a-ba-am ša-ni-am
english: Do we have any father but you?

oa: ni-šu a-na Tù-ùh-pi-a e-tí-iq-ma KÙ.B. 10 GÍN ù 1/3 ma-na ma-lá ga-am-ri-a: a-lá-qé-a-ma
english: I will travel on to Tuhpiya and try to get some silver, 10 or 20 shekels, as much as I need for my expenses,

oa: ù a-ta-bi4-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
english: then I will get moving and depart for you.

oa: a-bi4 a-ta DÍ-RI-ú
english: You, my father, <gap>!

oa: A-šur-UTU ù En-na-Sú-in iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma En-na-Sú-in-ma a-na A-šur-UTU-ma
english: Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen seized us and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī:

oa: KÙ.B. ki-iš-da-a dí-nam
english: Give me the silver that accrues to me.

oa: um-ma A-šur-UTU-ma KÙ.B. ú-lá a-da-na-kum a-na li-ta-tim ak-ru-ub-kà
english: Aššur-šamšī answered: I will/can not give you the silver, for I have <gap> you <gap> for <gap>.

oa: um-ma En-na-Sú-in-<ma> mi-šu-um a-ta i-a-tí ta-kà-ra-ba-ni
english: Ennam-Suen said: Why is it me that you are <gap> me?

oa: me-er-i-kà ku-ru-ub
english: Do it to your sons!

oa: um-ma A-šur-UTU-ma a-na ga-am-ri-kà a-na-ku a-za-za-kum
english: Aššur-šamšī answered: I will personally take your expenses for my account.

oa: IGI Zu-ba IGI Puzur4-IŠKUR A-lá-bu-um DUMU Zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
english: In the presence of Zuba (and) of Puzur-Adad; Ali-abum, son of Zia was our colleague.

oa: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-rum Kà-ni-eš i-di-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša A-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
english: For these words the Kanesh colony made us available and this tablet (with) our testimony we presented before Aššur's dagger.

oa: KIŠIB Zu-ba DUMU En-na-nim KIŠIB Puzur4-IŠKUR DUMU I-dí-Ištar
english: Seal of Zuba, son of Ennānum, seal of Puzur-Adad, son of Iddin-Ištar;

oa: A-lá-bu-um DUMU Zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
english: Ali-abum, son of Ziya, was our companion.

oa: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um Kà-né-eš i-di-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša A-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
english: For these words the Kaneš colony made us available and this tablet we gave as our testimony rendered before Aššur's dagger.

oa: a-na ṣé-er A-šur-UTU i-na ba-[áb] ha-ra-ni-šu né-ru-ub-ma um-ma En-na-Sú-[in] a-na A-šur-UTU-[ma]
english: We entered with Aššur-šamšī when he was about to go on a journey and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī:

oa: a-pu-na lá-ma kà-sà-am ni-iš-tí-ú: a-wa-tí-im lá-ta-wu-kum li-ba-tim lá ta-ma-lá
english: Please, before we drink from the cup I want to declare something to you, do not get angry!

oa: i-nu-mì i-n[a] Wa-áš-ha-ni-a ú-kà-i-lu-ni-n[i] 2 ma-na KÙ.B. a-ha-ti tù-šé-bi-lá-kà
english: When they detained me in Wašhaniya did my sister send you to me with 2 minas of silver?

oa: um-ma A-šur-[UTU] ke-na tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma ú-lá a-dí-na-kum
english: Aššur-šamšī answered: Sure, she sent me, but I did not give it to you.

oa: um-ma En-na-Sú-i[n]-ma u4-ma-am a-ha-tí ta-tù-ra-am um-ma ší-it-ma ta-al-tám-nam
english: Ennam-Suen then said: Today my sister has come back here and she said: You have done me wrong!

oa: KÙ.B. ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša iš-tù 8 ša-na-tim šé-ṣí-ma dí-nam
english: Produce the silver and its interest due since eight years and give it to me!

oa: um-ma A-šur-UTU-ma e-ni-ma-ma a-na šé-ep A-šur-i-mi-tí am-qú-ut: a-hu-ú-a: a-tù-nu
english: Aššur-šamšī answered: Just now I have humbly begged Aššur-imittī, saying: Please, my brothers,

oa: a-ma GUŠKIN 15 GÍN ù 1 ma-na sà-am-tum ma-lá ta-le-a-ni É.GAL-lam ṭá-i-ba
english: here are gold, 15 shekels, and 1 mina of carnelian, appease the palace as well as you can.

oa: um-ma A-šur-UTU-ma a-n[a] En-na-Sú-in-ma šu-ma KÙ.B. a-na ma-dí-im i-tù-ar al-kam-ma
english: Aššur-šamšī also said to Ennam-Suen: If the silver (due) has increased much then come here,

oa: ší-b[é]-kà la-aṣ-ba-a[t]-ma ma-e-pá-ší-im ep-ša-ni
english: let me seize your witnesses and do with me what you think best!

oa: um-ma En-na-in-ma a-na A-šur-UTU-ma É.GAL KÙ.B. ma-dam i-ṣé-ri-a <i-šu>
english: Ennam-Suen answered Aššur-šamšī as follows: The palace <has> a substantial silver claim on me <gap>.

oa: um-ma A-šur-i-mi-tí ù A-ku5-a-ma a-na DINGIR-ba-ni ù Sú-in-DINGIR-šu qi-bi-ma
english: Thus Aššur-imittī and Akūa, say to Ilī-bāni and Suen-ilšu:

oa: ta-ah-si-is-tam ša a-wa-at En-na-Sú-in ù A-šur-UTU ni-ig-mu-ru a-ma-kam
english: Look for the document (recording) that we settled the affair of Ennam-Suen and Aššur-šamšī,

oa: lu i-na qá-tí a-wil-il5-tim lu i-na ṭup-pé-e ša ku-nu-ki-ni am-ra-ma ma-la a-wa-tù-šu ga-am-ra-ni dí-na-šu-ma li-il5-ma-sí
english: either among what the lady has with her or among the tablets under our seals and give him the record declaring that his whole affair has been settled, so that he can take cognizance of it.

oa: lá-šu-a-at a-wa-tí-šu né-nu: nu-kà-a-al ù a-tù-nu a-ma-kam ma-lá tù-kà-lá-ni
english: If it is not there, we remember his words and you there must write down everything you remember,

oa: lá-pi-ta-ni-ma a-wa-at-ni a-na iš-té-et li-tur4-ma a-na-kam a-wa-sú lu ni-iq-bi4-šum
english: so that our statement becomes one and the same and we can tell him here (the outcome of) his affair.

oa: A-na-ah-i-lí ha-mu-uš-ni
english: Ānah-ilī was our fifth man.

oa: a-na DINGIR-ba-ni qi-bi4-ma ša 3 ma-na KÙ.B. ú-mu-kà e-ta-at-qú-ú ù KÙ.B. x-na-x at: im-tí-ṣí-x
english: Say to Ilī-bāni: Your term for the 3 minas of silver has passed and the silver <gap>

oa: ma-lá K[Ù.B. qá]-at-kà i-kà-[šu-d]u a-na En-na-Sú-in di-in-ma lu-ub-lam
english: Give all the silver you manage to acquire to Ennam-Suen to bring it here.

oa: ki-a-a-ma: wa-áš-ba-ku
english: It is for that reason that I am staying!

oa: 5 GÍN KÙ ig-ri-šu dí-in
english: Give him 5 shekels of silver as wages.

oa: um-ma A-šur-i-mi-tí-ma a-na En-nam-A-šur qi-bi4-ma
english: Thus Aššur-imittī, say to Ennam-Aššur:

oa: 5 né-nu a-wa-tí-ku-nu ni-ig-mu-ur-ma 24 TÚG.HI.A ma-ah-ri-ni i-ší-ik-nu
english: The five of us settled your affair and 24 textiles were submitted to us.

oa: 6 TÚG.HI.A Kà-zi-a ta-al-qé 18 TÚG.HI.A ší-tám En-na-Su-in ú-ba-li-iṭ-ma
english: 6 textiles Kaziya took, the remaining 18 textiles Ennam-Suen has made available as asset,

oa: lu ša li-tí-šu lu ša ma-ku-ur ša-bu-a-tí-ni a-na ša-al-ša-tí-ku-nu a-ta-wa
english: so that you are satisfied both with his <gap> and with what is <gap> About your one-third share you must negotiate.

oa: a-ma-kam ma-ma-an lá ú-ša-ha-az-kà-ma iš-tí a-hi-kà lá ta-ṣa-al iš-tí a-hi-kà lu ṭá-ba-tí
english: Over there nobody must instigate you to quarrel with your brother(s); be on good terms with your brother(s)!

oa: a-na As-q[ú-dim] ù A-bi4-lá qi-bi-ma [um-ma I]-dí-Sú-in-ma
english: Say to Asqudum and Abila thus Iddin-Suen:

oa: i-na UR[UDU A]-šur-i-dí URUDU SIG5 [a]-na En-na-Sú-in di-[in]
english: Give from Aššur-idī's copper 1 talent of refined copper to Ennam-Suen.

oa: a-hu-a a-tù-nu ih-da-ma URUDU A-šur-i-dí ša-áš-qi-lá: ù na-pá-al-tù-šu šu-up-ra-nim
english: Please, my brothers, take care to make Aššur-idī pay the copper and write me also his reaction.

oa: ù 5 GÚ URUDU ša Šu-Ištar li-iš-qú-ul ba-lu-um té-er-tí-a KI a-wí-lim i-mi-gi5-ir
english: He must also pay 5 talents of copper of Šu-Ištar. He has come to an agreement with the man without an instruction of mine.

oa: i-ša-ha-at En-na-Sú-in i-zi-za-ma a-na kà-ú-l[i-šu] ù ša-ku-*[li]-šu
english: Assist Ennam-Suen and be ready to support him and to provide him

oa: ma-h[a- x]
english: with food.

oa: a-hu-a-tù-nu ú-ṭù-tám lu tù-pá-qí-dá nu-dí-ma a-lá-nu-ma lá tù-pá-ra-dá-šu
english: Please, my brothers, you must provide (her?) with barley <gap>, and from there(?) you must not scare her.

oa: šú-ba-sà-a ù ší-it-ar-ša-a eṭ-ra-šu
english: Deprive her of her garment and her head-dress.

oa: a-na DUMU A-šur ù a-na DUMU Kà-né-eš lá ta-dá-na-šu a-na Ta-al-ha-tim dí-na-šu
english: You must not sell her to an Assyrian or to a citizen of Kanesh. Sell her to a man from Talhat

oa: ú a-ša-ar ta-dá-na-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na ma-at Kà-né-eš a-wí-il5-tám lá tù-ta-ra-nim
english: and where you sell (her) you must say: Do not bring the woman back to the land of Kanesh!

oa: um-ma Šu-Ištar-ma a-na En-na-Sú-in qi-bi-ma
english: Thus Šu-Ištar, say to Ennam-Suen:

oa: mi-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma 1/2 ma-na KÙ.B. hu-bu-lá-am a-ma-at-kà té-pu-uš
english: Why have you written me as follows: Your maid has contracted a debt of 1/2 mina of silver.

oa: a-šé-er ra-ga-at-ni ù hu-bu-lá-am a-na na-q-ki-ša-a té-pá-áš
english: She is not only wicked, but is also contracting a debt for her <gap>

oa: 10 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.B. šé-bu-lá-tim uš-té-bi4-lá-ší-im
english: I have sent her consignments of silver amounting to 10 minas and 10 shekels!

oa: a-ma-kam: a-ta ù-la ta-na-ṭá-al a-ma i-a-tí-i ta-[ṭ]á-ba-am
english: Over there, you are not even looking! Is it really to me that you are being nice?

oa: a-[a]m-tám ha-li-iq a-na Ta-al-ha-tim di-i-ší a-na DUMU A-šur lá ta-dá-[ší]
english: Get rid of the maid, sell her to a man from Talhat, do not sell her to an Assyrian!

oa: a-na Ku-ku-a En-na-Sú-in ù Ú-ṣú-<ur>-ša-A-šur qi-bi-ma um-ma Šu-Ištar-ma
english: Say to Kukua, Ennam-Suen and Uṣur-ša-Aššur, thus Šu-Ištar:

oa: a-ma-kam a-am-tám sà-ni-qá-ma i-na Ú-zi-ni-im e té-pu-uš-ma nu-a-am e ta-al-pu-ut a-ni-ša-am
english: Keep the maid there under control and let her not operate in Uzinum and not affect the native Anatolian.

oa: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma ší-it-ma šu-up-ra-ma ší-me-a ma-ma-an li-il5-qé
english: She wrote me here as follows: Send (somebody) to collect the price due to me.

oa: a-hu-a-tù-nu a-ma-kam am-tám sà-ni-qá-ma ú sí-li-a-ší-ma
english: May dear colleagues, keep the maid there under control and cheat her

oa: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na ṣé-er be-li-ki-i i-ra-de5-ú-ki lu sà-he-er-tí-ki lu KÙ.B. 1 GÍN tí-šu-i pá-hi-ri-ma
english: by telling her: One will conduct you to your lord. Collect your small goods and any silver you have

oa: KI a-li-ki-im pá-ni-ma a-na ṣé-er be-li-ki ta-li-ki a-na-ma tù-pá-hu-ru-ni
english: and then you will go to your lord with the first caravan! And as soon as she is gathering her belongings

oa: ṣú-ba-sà-a ù ša qá-qí-dí-ša-a eṭ-ra-ma a-na Ta-al-ha-tí-i-im di-na-ší a-na DUMU A-šur ù DUMU Kà-né-eš lá ta-dá-ší
english: deprive her of her garment and her head-dress and sell her to somebody from Talhat. Do not sell her to an Assyrian or to a citizen of Kanesh.

oa: ha-li-qá-áš ù ma-at Kà-ne-eš lá i-na-mar
english: Get rid of her and she shall never (again) be seen in the land of Kanesh!

oa: a-na A-šur-na-da Sú-in-il5-šu ù En-na-Su-in qi-bi-ma um-ma MAŠ LUGAL-ki-in-ma
english: To Aššur-nādā, Suen-ilšu, and Ennam-Suen, thus <gap> Šarrum-kēn:

oa: i-na Wa-áš-ha-ni-a ni-na-me-er-ma um-ma a-ta-ma TÚG.HI.A É.GAL-lúm ú-la it-ba-al a-ta-ma ta-at-ba-al-šu-nu
english: When we met in Wašhaniya you said: It was not the palace that took the textiles away, it was you who took them away!

oa: i-nu-mì ú-šé-ṣí-ú-ni a-na-ku lá-šu-<a>-ku: qá-tí É.GAL-lim-ma: 4 DUMU um-mi-a-nim iṣ-ba-at-ma È-tí
english: When it removed them I was not present, the palace itself seized four affiliated traders and they searched

oa: ú-na-dí-du-ma TÚG.HI-tí-kà ú-šé-ṣí-ú ṭup-pá-am a-ší-a-tí a-dí(TI)-a-kum
english: my house and removed your textiles. Therefore I drew up a tablet for you

oa: ú ší-bé-a az-ku-ra-kum ší-bé-a a-na ba-áb DINGIR ú-šé-ra-da-ma
english: and I named you my witnesses. I am ready to lead my witnesses down to the Gate of the god so that

oa: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-kí-šu(KU)-nu ša 4: šu-nu-tí ta-lá(TAL)-qé
english: you can acquire a tablet with their seals, those of these four men.

oa: a-hi a-ta: ša a-wa-tim né-nu šu-ma a-na ma-mi-tim ta-pá-li-li mu-ru-úṣ
english: Please my brother, are we men to fight? If you wish to start a judicial procedure to make me swear,

oa: li-bi-kà a-na ša ki-ma <ku-a-tí> lá-pí-ta-ma lu-ta-mí-ú-ni ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-a ša tù-kà-lu-ú a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí dí-in
english: write down you grievances for <your> representatives, so that they can make me swear. Give the tablet with my seal that you have in your possession to my representatives.

oa: šu-ma la ta-da-an ša-sí-hi-ma lu-ma lá-li-kam ma-aṣ-a-tí-ma a-ma-kam lu ni-ta-wu
english: If you do not wish that, have me transferred here, so that I can come to swear. You have taken the initiative, so let us discuss over there.

oa: um-ma I-dí-Sú-in-<ma> a-na En-na-Sú-in qi-bi4-ma šú-ha-ra-am ga-lá-ba-am [Ha]-dí-a-[šu x]-ra-dé-am
english: Thus Iddin-Suen, say to Ennam-Suen: The boy who is a barber Hadiaššu is leading to you.

oa: [dí]-u-m[a x x] li-qí KÙ.B. ku-šu-ud 3 ku-ta-ni ù TÚG a-bar-ni-am ša ta-ak-lu-ú
english: Sell him and collect his price, (and so) obtain silver. The 3 kutānu-textiles and the Abarnian one that you held back,

oa: a-na Ha-dí-a-šu dí-in-ma: lu-ub-lam a-dí: a-ma-kam wa-áš-ba-tí-ni sí-ku-šu kà-[il5]
english: give them to Hadiaššu to bring them to me. As long as you stay there you must hold him by his hem.

oa: šu-ma lá i-lá-kam kam
english: If he does not come <gap>

oa: um-ma I-dí-Sú-in-ma a-na Ilī5-ba-ni A-b[i-lá] ù En-na-Sú-in [qi-bi4-ma]
english: Thus Iddin-Suen say to Ilī-bāni, Abila and Enna(m)-Suen:

oa: i-na pá-na ú-nu-tí-[a] la-dí-a-am-ma mi-š[u] ú-nu-tí-a ta-at-ba-al-m[a] ni-kà-sí iš-tí-a ú-lá ta-sí ù u4-ma-[am] lu-qú-tí x ta-ar-de5-[a]-ma
english: I wished to deposit my goods at the start, so why have you taken away my goods without having settled accounts with me? And today you have taken along my merchandise

oa: ku-nu-ke ša a-bi4-a ù um-mi-a-ni-a ú-lá a-mu-ur ku-nu-ke tù-pá-ṭé-er-ma
english: and the seals of my father and my investor(s), you have broken these seals without me even having seen them and

oa: tu-BA-li-ih TÚG šu-ba-tám na-ar-ba-am a-ha-tí tù-šé-bi4-lam a-ta TÚG ta-ak-ta-lá
english: so have <gap> My sister sent me a soft garment, but you have held back that garment.

oa: šu-ma a-šu-um TÚG a-mì-e-im ki-ma ša a-bi4-kà na-pá-áš-ta-[kà] lá a-ki-is mi-nam ha-bu-lá-ku-ma 3 TÚG ṣú-[ba-tí-a] ta-ak-ta-lá
english: If, because of this textile, as if it were your father's, I have not cut your throat, what then do I owe you that you have held back 3 textiles of mine?

oa: ki-ma [a-ta] sà-ra-tí-ni-m[a <gap>] pu-ru-sà [i-dí]-ni a-na-ku lá i-de5-e mi-šum a-ta ú-nu-tí-a ta-at-[ba-al]
